summary_en: 680,000 shares (0.97% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) up to ¥1,000M authorization. Execution window June 25, 2026–June 24, 2027. Method not disclosed. Rationale: shareholder returns and capital policy framework.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On June 24, 2026, the board of Mitani Sekisan resolved to establish a new treasury share acquisition framework. The company will acquire up to 680,000 shares of common stock (0.97% of shares outstanding, calculated as 680,000 ÷ 70,252,120) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥1,000 million. The acquisition window runs from June 25, 2026 through June 24, 2027. The disclosure states the purpose as part of shareholder returns and capital policy strategy, but does not specify the execution method (open-market, ToSTNeT-3, or self-tender). The reference line confirms 70,252,120 shares outstanding excluding treasury (which held 13,694,276 shares as of the announcement date).
